dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical, gradual geometric narrowing from the mid-body towards the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins appear smooth with a subtle, symmetrical constriction observed immediately posterior to the head region.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white; significant specular highlights are present along the right dorsal flank due to surface water reflectance.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low spatial frequency of diffuse, darker grey patches concentrated at the anterior head and posterior peduncle regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between the lighter dorsal regions and the more pigmented grey extremities.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast, circular dark aperture (blowhole) clearly visible at the anterior terminus of the dorsal plane.
